title: Rigel, Hephaestus / Lexxir Division Director
summary: Withdrawn personnel record concerning Hephaestus Rigel, director of the Lexxir division responsible for Zephyr's model line.
body:
SUBJECT

RIGEL, HEPHAESTUS

Hephaestus Rigel is identified in surviving Lexxir documentation as the director of the division responsible for the legacy artificial-life programme associated with Zephyr's model line.

The division's full remit remains unclear. Its records concern the creation, modification and maintenance of legacy artificial individuals.

Rigel's position places him directly within the organisational history relevant to Zephyr. The extent of his personal involvement in Zephyr's creation or subsequent development has not been established.

NOVACLISS

Novacliss is identified as a subordinate researcher within Rigel's division. Surviving references indicate that Novacliss worked under Rigel's direction on research associated with the division.

ARCHIVE STATUS

This record has been withdrawn pending further review of Lexxir personnel and programme documentation.
